decision.reasoning_trace: The search results were cluttered with many non-backpack items such as towels, camping stoves, tents, and sleeping pads. Among the actual backpacks, most were highly specialized (baseball equipment bags, a snorkeling bag, or a cooler bag) rather than standard daypacks or travel backpacks. The tactical option (prod_backpacks_064) looked decent but had a very low review count, and the military Alice pack (prod_backpacks_005) was prohibitively expensive at $339.99. Given the lack of high-quality, general-purpose options, I decided not to make a purchase during this session.
